indstillinger.konto.cloud_hjaelp: The web app is the source of truth. The timer is shared with the web app, the extension and mobile
indstillinger.konto.web_hjaelp: Set up in {brand} on the web, e.g. Billy, Dinero and e-conomic
indstillinger.konto.plan_hjaelp: Limits are enforced on the server, exactly as on the web
indstillinger.konto.lokal_hjaelp: Your data is only stored on this computer
indstillinger.konto.import_hjaelp: Run a trial first. It shows what will be moved without changing anything. The import can be run again without creating duplicates
indstillinger.konto.licens_aktiveret: The license is activated. Thank you!
indstillinger.konto.logget_ud: You are signed out. This device is disconnected
indstillinger.sporing.privat: The app sees which programs and sites you use and suggests entries. Raw activity never leaves the computer
indstillinger.sporing.spor_hjaelp: When off, the app makes no suggestions
indstillinger.sporing.pause_hjaelp: Time without input this long does not count as work
indstillinger.sporing.dage_hjaelp: Older raw activity is deleted automatically. Confirmed entries are kept
indstillinger.sporing.url_hjaelp: Gives better suggestions based on the domain. When off, only the window title is used
indstillinger.sporing.vinduer_hjaelp: Private browsing in Safari, incognito in Chrome, Edge, Brave and Arc, and private windows in Firefox and Vivaldi are normally not tracked. When on, the window title is saved, but never the address
indstillinger.sporing.repos_hjaelp: Folders with git repos. Used to recognize projects
indstillinger.ai.forklaring: AI is only used for blocks the app is unsure about. Answers are saved as patterns. Everything still works without AI
indstillinger.ai.indbygget_hjaelp: Runs on your computer, even offline. Downloaded from Hugging Face
indstillinger.ai.model_hentet: The model is downloaded and runs offline
indstillinger.ai.servere_tom: None found. Start Ollama, LM Studio, Jan or llamafile, and search again
indstillinger.ai.fundet_hjaelp: Models that other apps have already downloaded. They are used straight from their own folder, so there is no copy and no extra download. Only the file headers are read, and nothing leaves the computer
indstillinger.ai.fundet_ram: This computer has {ram} GB of memory. Recommended means the model is well suited and uses at most half of it
indstillinger.ai.fundet_tom: No language models from other apps found. Press Search again if you just downloaded one
indstillinger.ai.fundet_delt: Using the model from {program} (shared, no extra download)
indstillinger.ai.fundet_soeg_aria: Search the computer for models again
indstillinger.ai.fundet_andre_one: 1 other AI model found, not a language model
indstillinger.ai.fundet_andre: {n} other AI models found, not language models
indstillinger.ai.ollama_stoppet: Ollama is installed but not running
indstillinger.ai.ollama_stoppet_hjaelp: Start it if you want to use its models. It keeps running until you quit it
indstillinger.ai.cloud_bekraeft_foerst: Confirm the warning under Cloud first
indstillinger.ai.cloud_advarsel_aria: Warning: Titles leave the machine. With cloud AI, window and tab titles from unclear blocks are sent to the provider with your own key. Everything else stays local
indstillinger.ai.cloud_advarsel_tekst: With cloud AI, window and tab titles from unclear blocks are sent to the provider with your own key. Everything else stays local.
indstillinger.ai.cloud_forstaaet: I understand that titles are sent to the provider
indstillinger.ai.noegle_gemt: The key for {udbyder} is saved in the keychain
